history.P3: Actual system replies within each session
history.P1: Reference history supplied by the benchmark

fixed_inputs.protocol: 20 alternating comparisons per corpus and scope. Query triplet i uses index rows 5i+1 through 5i+3 (zero based). Scope is either all passage IDs or every third ID, starting at zero. Each arm returns top 50 separately for each vector. Times are median milliseconds per call.

reference_window_intervention.scope: Qwen3-32B BF16, C=4. Candidate pools and first batches replayed on saved P3 histories. Delivered spans use actual selected source ranges.

source_pair.protocol: All 34 turns in the 120-turn queue with one delivered source, no read or reduce call, no full reference span delivered, and at least one first-batch window containing a full reference span. Substitute the window covering the most reference spans; ties use frozen Jina relevance. Recompile both branches with the same preceding actual conversation, question, answer instruction and one source. Alternate arm order by wave of up to four; flush KV per arm; Native, natural completion. Engine timing begins at submission; excludes retrieval and scoring.

native_prefill_replay.source: Previous submitted request for each MultiDoc2Dial training question, using actual P3 history
native_prefill_replay.mode: Native exact, one generated token per request, isolated cache namespaces, cleared before each concurrency group
native_prefill_replay.comparison: Legacy EMA recomputed from per-request forward-entry/finished timestamps on the same run. Batch CUDA events include graph replay or eager execution; tokens are counted once per batch.

residency_replay.preparation: Reverse the same sources before each answer, warm separately with Native or InfoFlow, retain historical revisit markers on both arms.
residency_replay.metrics: ready counts resident independent tokens from the snapshot; opportunity counts a complete resident block beyond the native prefix.

named_document_pairs.method: Fixed original spans, source IDs, question and ordering. Same directed mention in both instructions; the treatment adds the two document titles. Cold Native generation at concurrency four, alternating arm order by batch, followed by Loong official scoring.

tight_pool_loong.measurement: Same 40 tasks. One earlier candidate attempt ended with 39 scored after an HTTP read error; the full candidate cohort was run again.
